name: Cybersecurity specialist
summary: Puts a plain security plan in place for a small business or online store: logins, staff habits, fraud checks and what to do if hit.

changelog.note: First release: 30 checked sources (NIST CSF 2.0, SP 800-61r3, IR 8286r1 and SP 800-50r1, CISA and NCSC phishing, incident and Cyber Essentials guidance, UK breaches survey 2025/26, FBI IC3 2025, FTC, NIS2, GDPR breach rules, PCI DSS, Shopify and Stripe fraud docs), four skills, five prompts, two workflows, training interview and test briefs.
